notes: Research-only feature gate; not a standalone trading strategy and not implementation-ready.
Blocks or permits future long research entries based on funding state; does not generate entries by itself.
Targets crowded-long avoidance and possible short-squeeze/rebound context without reviving failed OHLCV candidates.
Funding state alone must not create an entry. Future validation requires a separately predeclared base entry/exit stream.
Each market uses its own OKX USDT-swap funding. BTC funding may be reported as diagnostic, not used to gate all markets in the primary candidate.
At 8h cadence, approximately 60 days. Structural default chosen for enough observations without short-window overfit.
Block all new long entries for that market when true.
Observation tag only in primary candidate; no extra sizing, leverage, or standalone long trigger.
Future long mean-reversion entries are eligible only in neutral-to-negative funding conditions and only if not positive_extreme.
neutral_positive means funding is positive and percentile > 50 but < 90; blocked to keep primary candidate contrarian/avoidance-focused.
Do not infer, synthesize, or forward-fill missing funding.
OI excluded because audit classified OI as partially_usable; historical OI is constrained and not exact instrument-specific via current route.
